issue.title: 2.4.0 on windows fails due to /\templates\_base.html: file does not exist

repository.name: prometheus
repository.description: The Prometheus monitoring system and time series database.

issue.body:
with prometheus 2.4.0 on windows, the default web page, http://localhost:9090/graph, fails with:

```
error reading base template: open /\templates\_base.html: file does not exist
```

any idea how to fix this?

to reproduce, just unpack the binaries, start prometheus, and access the [default web page](http://localhost:9090).
